messages.content:
The issue seems to be related to the handling of long options in the Apache Commons CLI library. The `DefaultParser` class provides a `parse` method that is used to parse command-line arguments according to the provided options.

Looking at the failing test `testExactOptionNameMatch`, it creates a `DefaultParser` instance and attempts to parse an array of strings containing the option `--prefix`. This test is likely checking for an exact match of the option name.

The current bug report mentions that parsing `--import=FILE` is not possible since version 1.3 of the library because it throws an `AmbiguousOptionException`. This exception indicates that the parser cannot decide between options due to ambiguity.

Inspecting the `DefaultParser.parse` method, it takes `Options` and an array of arguments as input. The parsing logic within this method might be incorrectly handling cases where there are ambiguities between option names.

Based on this information, the bug seems to be in the `DefaultParser` class, particularly in the parsing logic that deals with ambiguous options. The change in behavior from version 1.2 to 1.3 mentioned in the bug report might have introduced this issue.

Next, I will provide suggestions on where the code could be fixed.
`org.apache.commons.cli.DefaultParser.parse(org.apache.commons.cli.Options,java.lang.String[])`

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
